    mutate(
      colour_group = case_when(
        vistype %in% c("adjacent", "triple_CI") ~ "red",
        vistype == "basic" ~ "blue",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
    
      display_label = unname(
        vistype_labels[as.character(vistype)]
      ),
    
      vistype = factor(
        vistype,
        levels = unique(vistype)
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
      aes(
    x = estimated_rating,
    y = vistype,
    colour = colour_group
  )
  ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = lower_ci,
        xmax = upper_ci
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0.16,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5) +

    # Estimated values
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", estimated_rating)),
      nudge_y = 0.32,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 6
    ) +

    # Custom y-axis labels
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(
        x = 0.78,
        y = vistype,
        label = display_label,
        colour = colour_group
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8,

    scale_colour_manual(

) +

    scale_x_continuous(

    ) +

    # Hide ordinary y-axis labels

    # Show custom labels placed slightly outside the panel
    coord_cartesian(

      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),

       plot.margin = margin(

    l = 200
  )
    )

      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )
  }

  p
